svg.aria-label: Breadboard wiring: a TinyFPGA BX and a 1602A LCD on a breadboard. BX pins 1-7 go to the LCD RS, E, RW and D4-D7; BX 3.3V and GND feed the breadboard power rails; the LCD VDD and backlight anode go to 3.3V, VSS and cathode to GND, and VO to the wiper of a 10k trimmer whose ends go to 3.3V and GND.
svg.text: 4-bit HD44780. Everything at 3.3 V (no level shifter). Clock is the BX on-board 16 MHz (nothing to wire).
